text: answer[linuxshort-3405ebb7]: Deliver a 16:9 video file at 1920×1080 (or higher, e.g. 3840×2160) with a total runtime of 90 seconds or less. Use a standard codec such as H.264 MP4 or ProRes for editing delivery. Confirm frame rate (24/25/30fps) matches the project spec. Before exporting, trim or pace the timeline to stay under 90 seconds. Validate aspect ratio in your NLE project settings and ensure no letterboxing alters the true 16:9 frame. Test the export in a player to verify resolution and duration.
